phases.label: Now
phases.note: Cyclone confirmed and track forecast issued

phases.label: T-36 h
phases.note: Begin evacuation of low-lying coastal villages

phases.label: T-24 h
phases.note: Shelters open, ports and sea travel closed

phases.label: T-12 h
phases.note: Planned power and telecom shutdowns, everyone indoors

phases.label: Landfall
phases.note: Emergency response on standby, no movement outdoors

Authorities.a: Activate the state emergency operations centre
Pre-position NDRF and SDRF teams in Raigad, Thane and Mumbai
Order evacuation of low-lying wards within 5 km of the shore
Open all cyclone shelters and confirm food and water stocks
Plan suspension of suburban rail, metro and flights before winds pass 70 km/h

Coastal communities.a: Secure homes and move valuables and documents to higher floors
Move to the nearest cyclone shelter before the winds pass 90 km/h
Keep a radio, torch and drinking water ready
Stay indoors until officials announce it is safe

Fisheries and shipping.a: Recall all boats and trawlers from the Arabian Sea
Evacuate offshore platforms at Mumbai High
Hold vessels at Mumbai Port and JNPT and suspend cargo handling

Power and telecom.a: Inspect and secure towers and substations on the coast
Prepare staged shutdown of coastal feeders
Position repair crews inland for restoration

Agriculture and industry.a: Harvest standing crops in Raigad and Ratnagiri where possible
Move stock away from low-lying industrial areas
Plan shutdown of coastal plants and chemical units
